title: Unprocessed or Minimally Processed
description: Whole foods in their natural form or cleaned, chilled, ground, or fermented without adding industrial fats, sugars, or salt.
impact: Optimal nutrient density, intact cellular matrix, and highest health score.

title: Processed Culinary Ingredients
description: Substances extracted directly from nature or Group 1 foods, used in kitchens to season and cook whole foods.
examples: Iodized sea salt and culinary starches
impact: Safe and beneficial when used in moderate home-cooking proportions.

title: Processed Foods
description: Products made by adding Group 2 culinary ingredients (salt, oil, sugar) to Group 1 foods for preservation or palatability.
examples: Canned legumes or vegetables in brine
Freshly baked sourdough or artisan bread
Roasted salted nuts and canned fish
impact: Healthy in balanced dietary patterns; monitor sodium and added sugar.

title: Ultra-Processed Foods (UPFs)
description: Industrial formulations typically containing five or more ingredients including emulsifiers, artificial flavors, synthetic dyes, and preservatives.
impact: Associated with metabolic disruption, gut barrier alteration, and overconsumption.
